import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] inputA = new int[3];
        int[] inputB = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) inputA[i] = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) inputB[i] = sc.nextInt();

        int[] inputA2 = inputA.clone();
        int[] inputB2 = inputB.clone();

        int lostMax = getLostMaxFast(inputA2, inputB2);
        int wonMax = getWonMaxFast(inputA, inputB);

        System.out.println((n - lostMax) + " " + wonMax);
    }

    private static int getWonMaxFast(int[] inputA, int[] inputB) {
        int[] wins = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            int good = (i + 1) % 3;
            wins[i] = Math.min(inputA[i], inputB[good]);
            inputA[i] -= wins[i];
            inputB[good] -= wins[i];
        }
        return wins[0] + wins[1] + wins[2];
    }

    private static int getLostMaxFast(int[] inputA, int[] inputB) {
        int[][] waysToLose = {{0, 2}, {1, 0}, {2, 1}, {0, 0}, {1, 1}, {2, 2}};
        List<int[]> waysList = Arrays.asList(waysToLose);
        List<List<int[]>> permutations = new ArrayList<>();
        generatePermutations(waysList, 0, permutations);

        int maxLost = 0;

        for (List<int[]> permutation : permutations) {
            int[] inputACopy = inputA.clone();
            int[] inputBCopy = inputB.clone();
            int currentLostSum = 0;

            for (int[] wayToLose : permutation) {
                int lostAdd = Math.min(inputACopy[wayToLose[0]], inputBCopy[wayToLose[1]]);
                inputACopy[wayToLose[0]] -= lostAdd;
                inputBCopy[wayToLose[1]] -= lostAdd;
                currentLostSum += lostAdd;
            }

            if (currentLostSum > maxLost) {
                maxLost = currentLostSum;
            }
        }
        return maxLost;
    }

    private static void generatePermutations(List<int[]> list, int start, List<List<int[]>> result) {
        if (start == list.size()) {
            result.add(new ArrayList<>(list));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = start; i < list.size(); i++) {
            Collections.swap(list, start, i);
            generatePermutations(list, start + 1, result);
            Collections.swap(list, start, i);
        }
    }
}
